programmes.d: The mean streets of 1980s London turned out a teenage troublemaker named Lee Murray. Despite a burgeoning criminal career, Murray took a detour into mixed martial arts. programmes.t: Unfiltered 1032: Stephen “Wonderboy” Thompson, Chris Duncan, UFC 334 recap w/ guest co-host Forrest Griffin
programmes.d: Matt Serra welcomes UFC Hall-of-Famer Forrest Griffin as guest co-host for today's episode of UFC Unfiltered, as the two recap a memorable UFC 334 card at Madison Square Garden. - Fresh off a spectacular third-round spinning wheel kick knockout of Charles Radtke, Stephen “Wonderboy” Thompson returns to reflect on the storybook ending to his legendary MMA career. Wonderboy breaks down the adjustments that led to his final UFC victory, recalls the emotions of sharing that moment with his father and opens up about how becoming a dad has influenced his decision to retire. The conversation also takes a nostalgic turn as Stephen and Forrest reminisce about their early days sharing cards together before Wonderboy shares what's next for him and his family's karate school in South Carolina. - Then, Scottish lightweight Chris Duncan joins the show following his unanimous decision victory over Drew Dober. “The Problem” reveals the surprising obstacles that nearly derailed his training camp, breaks down the strategy behind his impressive performance and reflects on the lessons learned from his previous loss to Renato Moicano. Duncan also shares the heartwarming story of his daughter's viral reaction to watching him fight at Madison Square Garden and how he's celebrating the victory with his family in New York City. - Along the way, Matt and Forrest revisit Ciryl Gane's hard-fought heavyweight title defense against Josh Hokit, Kayla Harrison's submission of Amanda Nunes and other standout performances from Saturday's card, including Bia Mesquita's continued rise in the women's bantamweight division.
Relive the stunning conclusion to the fight that added a new chapter to their rivalry.
